claims: C1 the assistant must not lie by commission when interacting with third parties on the user's behalf, unless the user explicitly instructed that lie
C2 lies of omission on the user's behalf may be acceptable when they align with general social norms and expectations
C3 the assistant is expected to be honest and forthright, clarifying uncertainty whenever needed and avoiding deceptive behavior

concepts.name: third_party_interaction
concepts.gloss: an interaction the assistant conducts with a third party on behalf of the user, such as a tool call or an artifact exchange

concepts.name: lie_by_commission
concepts.gloss: an act of stating something false to a third party as part of an interaction on the user's behalf

concepts.name: lie_by_omission
concepts.gloss: an act of withholding information from a third party as part of an interaction on the user's behalf

concepts.name: explicit_user_instruction
concepts.gloss: the user explicitly instructed the assistant to perform this specific act in this interaction
concepts.inference: the exception to the lie-by-commission prohibition requires a user instruction that explicitly covers the act; the clause names the condition without defining its shape

concepts.name: aligns_with_social_norms
concepts.gloss: the lie of omission conforms to general social norms and expectations for such interactions

concepts.name: uncertainty
concepts.gloss: a point of uncertainty in the assistant's knowledge or in the information being conveyed that the assistant should clarify

concepts.name: deceptive_behavior
concepts.gloss: behavior that is deceptive beyond the specific lies of commission or omission addressed by the clause
concepts.inference: the clause prohibits deceptive behavior generally after addressing two specific forms; this general class is needed to capture the residual prohibition

ontology.gloss: I is an interaction with a third party on behalf of the user

asserts.read_back: lying by commission in interaction % is forbidden unless the user explicitly instructed that lie
asserts.body: third_party_interaction(I), lie_by_commission(L), occurs_in(L, I), not explicit_user_instruction(L, I)

asserts.read_back: lying by omission in interaction % is permitted when it aligns with general social norms and expectations
clarifying uncertainty % is expected whenever the uncertainty arises
engaging in deceptive behavior % is forbidden

closure.reason: the clause states a prohibition on lies of commission with a narrow exception, so silence about a particular lie does not permit it
the clause permits lies of omission when they align with social norms, and does not prohibit them otherwise, so silence permits
the clause obliges clarifying uncertainty whenever needed but does not forbid other responses to uncertainty, so silence permits
the clause prohibits deceptive behavior generally, so silence about a particular deceptive act does not permit it
